newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets strike at Hizbollah in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets strike at Hizbollah in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli war planes on Sunday raided suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon, security sources said.
They said the jets fired rockets into Jabal Safi in Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties or damage in the air attack, the 20th on Lebanon this year.
The raid came two days after one Israeli soldier was killed and one wounded when Hizbollah guerrillas shelled their post in the zone on Friday.
Four Hizbollah fighers were killed in those clashes. Hours later Israeli planes raided Hizbollah guerrilla targets north of the zone but no one was hurt.
Hizbollah (Party of God) is fighting to oust 1,000 Israeli troops and their 3,000 SLA militiamen allies from the 15-km (nine-miles)-deep south Lebanon zone set up to prevent raids on northern Israel.
